# Velimir Paleksic Thumbnail Design

> Thumbnail design hub for creators, with portfolio examples, redesigns, pricing, proof, and direct contact options.

## Key links

- [Homepage](https://thumbnails.velimirpaleksic.com/): Main thumbnail offer.
- [Portfolio](https://thumbnails.velimirpaleksic.com/#portfolio): Selected thumbnail work.
- [Redesigns](https://thumbnails.velimirpaleksic.com/#redesigns): Before-and-after examples.
- [Pricing](https://thumbnails.velimirpaleksic.com/#pricing): Thumbnail packages.
- [Proof](https://thumbnails.velimirpaleksic.com/#proof): YTJobs feedback and trust signals.
- [Contact](https://thumbnails.velimirpaleksic.com/#contact): Direct contact section.
